name: zsnd_group_load_from_config_node
description: zSndGroup_LoadFromConfigNode allocates one runtime sound group and loads group-level options, child config blocks, and default child weights from a reader array.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted before the direct parser source-shape cleanup with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs; the closest profiles were vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs with 909 unmasked mismatches. Rerun VC5 before using this as tier S evidence.

The former local StoreFloatField, StoreRepeatCount, ReportConfigError, ArrayBase/ArrayCount, and NormalizeDefaultWeights helper delegation was removed; the source now emits direct numeric parser branches, zError call sites, array access, and default-weight normalization.
Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around inline string compares rendered with unimplemented sbb flag IL and some zReader node-array pointer displays.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a4590 validates the array-type guard, 0xb8-byte zSndGroup allocation, createGuard initialization, parsing of group name, DELAY_REPEAT, DELAY_TERMINATION, DYNAMIC_WEIGHTS with clamping, PLAY_SOLO, REPEAT, child config block allocation/loading through zSndGroup_LoadConfigBlock, and 100-percent default weight normalization across child blocks.

The native load-and-queue smoke verifies a loaded group carries the expected name, delay fields, dynamic-weight state/clamp, play-solo flag, repeat count, two child config blocks, and normalized default child weights.
